Germany Considers Joining UK-Italy-Japan Fighter Jet Project

Germany is reportedly considering joining the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), a fighter jet project involving the United Kingdom, Italy, and Japan. This potential move follows speculation that the GCAP could be open to Germany after a rival Franco-German fighter program reportedly collapsed in June. However, one report suggests Germany's involvement could delay the project for Britain by up to two years.
